items.title: BSB theme + host-based selection from first paint (#84)
items.description: Visiting calendar.bsquarebulletin.com renders the BSB skin (red accent, Lora serif body, warm-neutral surfaces) automatically from first paint; every other host renders default community-calendar theme exactly as today. Done when: xmlui/themes/b-square-bulletin.json exists as first-class fork file with spec values; xmlui/config.json registers it; xmlui/boot-decisions.js defines window.getThemeIdForHost and loads before shell.js; shell.js sets window.ccThemeId pre-render and Main.xmlui binds defaultTheme with literal fallback; test.html theme groups pass in regression-tests.yml.
items.notes: Added b-square-bulletin.json (spec values from #83/prototype), registered it in config.json, created boot-decisions.js with getThemeIdForHost, loaded it before shell.js and tests, set ccThemeId pre-render, bound defaultTheme with fallback, added 5-case theme group to test.html. Seam: theme-only file now; resolveCity lands with #85. Verified: node assertions pass, make test 95 passed, make lint clean.

items.title: Single-city boot default (skip the picker) (#85)
items.description: On a single-entry City list, calendar root without ?city= loads that City immediately with canonical ?city=<slug> URL; multi-city hosts and explicit deep-links behave as today. Done when: window.resolveCity(cityParam, cityKeys) in boot-decisions.js implements generic single-entry default with verbatim passthrough; boot path applies resolved City before prefetch with replaceState touching only city key; null/unloaded list guarded with no picker-markup change; test.html City-default groups pass in regression-tests.yml.
items.notes: Seam decision (pre-approved, unattended loop): window.resolveCity(cityParam, cityKeys) pure in boot-decisions.js; shell.js derives keys from window._cities (array or object map, null-guarded) and applies resolved City before prefetch with replaceState on city key only. Added resolveCity group to test.html. Verified: 13 node assertions pass, make test 95 passed, make lint clean.

items.title: Branded masthead + footer chrome (#86)
items.description: Every standalone screen (picker, list/multicol, dashboard) carries the paper's masthead and footer; embeds stay chrome-free and in-app controls stay in place. Done when: BrandHeader (vendored BSB logo same-tab link, sub-label, 4px red rule, Inter, hidden on embed) and BrandFooter (red bar, 4 spec links with correct tab targets, copyright line, Inter, hidden on embed) exist; logo vendored under icons/ and registered in config.json; both included via IncludeMarkup with ?v=APP_VERSION in each standalone block; picker redundant heading dropped with city-name heading and controls intact.
items.notes: Added components/BrandHeader.xmlui (Fragment; logo Link to= paper same-tab, versioned vendored SVG, black bold letter-spaced sub-label, borderBottom 4px solid $color-primary, Inter, when !window.embed) and BrandFooter.xmlui (Fragment; $color-primary bar, 4 spec links via Link+Text with correct targets, no portal links, copyright line, Inter, embed-gated); vendored icons/BSB_Logo-2-color-horiz.svg from BSB Ghost CDN (script-free, valid XML) and registered as icon.bsb-logo in config.json; wired 3 header + 3 footer IncludeMarkup includes (?v=APP_VERSION, per-block when gates) in Main.xmlui covering picker/list/dashboard and dropped the picker H1. Seam decision (pre-approved, unattended): no pure-logic seam exists, so left a fetch-based 'Brand chrome (#86)' group in test.html (5 tests, runs in CI Playwright step over http) as the durable regression test. Link/Image/Text props verified against engine metadata and in-repo precedent (Link to= + children, no href). Verified: 26 node acceptance checks pass, served-markup checks pass over local http, test.html syntax OK, make test 95 passed, make lint clean.

items.title: BSB font delivery (Lora + Inter) (#87)
items.description: Body text renders in Lora and brand chrome in Inter by loading the webfonts the way the paper delivers them. Done when: index.html loads Lora + Inter mirroring the paper's own font delivery with fallback stacks intact; rendered typography verified visually against bsquarebulletin.com with no silent system-font fallback.
